mapper.insert: insert into tb_gift(name, description, image, like_count, star_count, usage_sex, usage_age, create_time, update_time, creator) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{image}, #{likeCount}, #{starCount}, #{usageSex}, #{usageAge}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{creator})
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.image, g.creator AS creator_id, u.name AS creator_name, u.avatar AS creator_avatar, IFNULL(fav_counts.count, 0) AS favorite_count, IFNULL(collect_counts.count, 0) AS collect_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_gift_favorite WHERE gift_id = g.id AND user_id = #{creatorId} ) AS is_favorited_by_user, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_gift_collect WHERE gift_id = g.id AND user_id = #{creatorId} ) AS is_collected_by_user FROM (SELECT gift_id FROM tb_gift_collect WHERE user_id = #{creatorId}) as user_fav JOIN tb_gift g ON user_fav.gift_id = g.id JOIN tb_user u ON g.creator = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gift_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_gift_favorite GROUP BY gift_id ) fav_counts ON g.id = fav_counts.gift_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gift_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_gift_collect GROUP BY gift_id ) collect_counts ON g.id = collect_counts.gift_id ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(create_time) FROM tb_gift_collect WHERE gift_id = g.id AND user_id = #{creatorId}) DESC limit #{start},#{pageSize}
